source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

concepts.label: Monitoring dashboard metric graph (Capella UI)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - kept minimal; used only as the seeAlso subject, since the ~135 individual PromQL-backed graphs are implementation detail rather than distinct Capella concepts

notable_absence.finding: This is a ~135-row table of raw PromQL expressions (one per UI dashboard graph, e.g. 'sum by (bucket) (bucket:kv_ep_db_file_size_bytes:sum{...})') with a Graph Name and free-text Description per row. Confirms the batch hypothesis strongly: there is no product-specific 'thing' to mint here beyond the generic monitoring:metric-graph placeholder used only as the seeAlso subject for the See Also section - the PromQL metric names themselves are implementation details of the underlying Prometheus/exporter stack, not Capella-domain concepts, and no row contains edition/version/provider-conditional language of any kind.

cross_component_finding: The mere existence of Columnar-service and Data-Encryption-at-rest metric rows here (e.g. 'Columnar: CPU Utilization by Node', 'Data: Data Encryption Keys In Use by Node') confirms those are current, monitored Capella features, consistent with encryption-at-rest and Columnar concepts surfaced in other batches' extractions, but this page itself adds no new relation - it is purely corroborating background, not a new source of ontology.
